label: ingest — AST-aware & heading-aware chunkers
summary: Added chunker system to @adhd/sox-ingest: Chunker interface, ChunkerRegistry, AST-aware chunker (tree-sitter for TS/Python/Java/C#), heading-aware chunker (Markdown/MDX/RST/AsciiDoc), source-map on every chunk, error classes

changes.kind: created — Chunker interface, Chunk, SourceMap types
fixed 9 TS errors (exactOptionalPropertyTypes, unused import, impossible comparison)

issues: ast-chunker uses a simplified implementation (not full tree-sitter WASM) for tests per spec instruction
handoff_notes: Chunker registry is populated at build time via static constructors — no runtime registration
Chunker selection: heading chunker runs first (order: 0), AST chunker on fenced code blocks (order: 1)
SourceMap.sourceUrl and parentDocId are optional — use conditional spread to respect exactOptionalPropertyTypes
